newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Mubarak arrives in Morocco for Mideast talks.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak arrives in Morocco for Mideast talks.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak arrived in Morocco on Friday for talks with King Hassan on the faltering Middle East peace process and Jerusalem where Israel is planning a new settlement.
King Hassan and Crown Prince Mohamed greeted Mubarak at the airport as he flew in after a visit to the United States and talks with President Bill Clinton.

Mubarak made no statement but Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told Reuters: "Talks between his majesty King Hassan and President Mubarak will focus on the Arab position on the Middle East peace process, including the situation of Jerusalem.
"They will also discuss other issues in the Arab world."
Israel said on Friday it would go ahead with plans to build 6,500 homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem despite a United Nations call for it to cancel the project.
Western and Arab leaders accuse Israel of endangering Middle East peacemaking and risking a violent Palestinian reaction by insisting on tightening its grip on Jerusalem.
Moussa said Mubarak and King Hassan would hold two rounds of talks on Friday and the Egyptian leader would leave for home on Saturday.

A Palestinian diplomat at the airport said the two leaders would concentrate on the issue of Jerusalem and that arrangements were ready for a meeting in Rabat of the 15-member Al Qods (Jerusalem) committee, which is headed by King Hassan. He gave no date.
